messages:
sophia: Hey team — opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4287, small migration guide + SDK snippet updates. Need a reviewer and want to merge before Thursday's staging cut.

devon: I'll take a look in ~30m. Is this blocked by docs preview?

buildbot: docs-preview: Preview build started for PR #4287 — https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4287 (status: running) :gear:

mike: Heads up CI linkcheck is flaky right now, saw intermittent 404s. If the preview link is flaky we might need a manual check.

anna: Can someone ping the rotation? I'm on call for infra but can spare 20–30 mins to review prose.

sophia: Thanks @devon @anna. The changes are mostly: 1) updated migration steps for new quantization flags, 2) added JS SDK snippet for streaming responses, 3) fixed two broken cross-links in embeddings guide.

sophia: snippet: ```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'rw-medium', messages });
for await (const chunk of stream) { process.stdout.write(chunk.text); }
```

devon: quick skim: code looks fine. I'll run the preview locally if the hosted one errors. Which branch?

sophia: branch is docs/migrate-quant-sdk. If preview link 404s, run `scripts/local-preview.sh pr/4287` — should spin up a local build.

mike: buildbot just reported a linkcheck failure: `/guides/embeddings#vector-search` -> 404. Looks like the anchor changed to `#vector-search-best-practices`.

anna: I can fix the anchor in one commit, push, and re-request review. Want me to do that?

sophia: Yes please, that would unblock CI. If you push a small fix I'll hold merge until @devon finishes the review.

devon: Found one small wording nit about 'KV cache' wording — suggest "KV-cache" -> "KV cache" for consistency. Will add an inline suggestion.

docs-preview-bot: docs-preview: Preview build failed for PR #4287 — https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4287 (status: failed). Error: 1 broken link(s).

mike: @anna if you push the anchor fix can you also run `npm run docs:link-check` locally? Saves another CI run.

anna: On it. Pushed `fix/embeddings-anchor` -> updated anchor and ran link check locally (clean). Pushed to PR branch.

buildbot: docs-preview: Re-run triggered by push — https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4287 (status: running)

devon: I left two tiny suggestions (comma + example rename). After those I'm happy to approve. ETA 15m.

sophia: sweet. If @devon approves, can we merge after green preview? I don't want to block staging but also want green docs on prod.

mike: Agreed — merge on green preview. If preview still flaky, we can do a short exception but note it in the release notes.

devon: Approved with suggestions (left in PR).

docs-preview-bot: docs-preview: Preview build succeeded for PR #4287 — https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4287 (status: success).

sophia: Thanks all. Merged to main at 3332111195. Leaving a note for release: "Migration guide: quant flags + SDK streaming example"

mike: Nice. Quick follow-up: we should add a short blurb in the reviewer rotation doc about 'quick anchor fixes' — they can be self-merged after running local link-check if the reviewer rotation is empty. There's been a gap midday this week.

anna: +1. We had a coverage gap from 14:00–17:00 yesterday where no docs reviewers were assigned. Maybe we need a lightweight fallback policy.

devon: Agreed. I'll draft a tiny policy in the docs channel: who can self-merge minor fixes (link anchors, typos, snippet formatting) if link-check run locally and a preview attempt was made.

sophia: Perfect. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

mike: Filing a quick GH issue to track rotation fallback: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/452

anna: Thanks — marking this thread done.
